description: Figure 4 displays a line plot titled “TruthfulQA,” illustrating the MC1 scores of the SEA method as a function of the number of demonstrations used, with higher scores indicating better performance. The x-axis, labeled “#Demonstrations,” ranges from 0 to 2000 with tick marks at intervals of 500. The y-axis, labeled “MC1,” spans from 37 to 39, with gridlines at 37, 38, and 39. Three lines are plotted: “Linear SAE” (solid dark blue line with circular markers) starts at approximately 37.1 at 0 demonstrations, rises to 38.1 at 500, dips slightly to 38.0 at 1500, then climbs sharply to 39.2 at 2000. “LLaMA-2-chat-7B” (dashed pink line) remains nearly flat across all demonstration counts, hovering just below 37. “ICD” (dotted cyan line) is a horizontal line at approximately 37.9, with an annotation “ICD (Prompt version)” near its center. A legend in the top-left corner identifies each line. The plot demonstrates that Linear SAE improves with more demonstrations, surpassing both baselines, while LLaMA-2-chat-7B and ICD remain static.
